headline: Proposed Elementary School Reassignment Policy JG-R, plus a $295,000.00 grant and strategic plan survey results.
summary: The main new business is a proposed elementary school reassignment policy, offered by Member Reinfeld. The agenda also covers a grant, a strategic plan update, and a Medford High School late bus presentation.
items: Consent agenda: approval of bills and payrolls
Consent agenda: approval of a $295,000.00 grant from Beth Israel Lahey Health, Inc. for City of Medford on behalf of the Medford Public Schools
Consent agenda: approval of a Mobile Gas donation to Brooks Elementary School
Strategic Plan Update by Dr. Suzanne B. Galusi, Superintendent, including results of the Strategic Plan Survey
Presentation by the Student Advisory Council on the Medford High School Late Bus
Presentations of the Public, not to begin before 7:00 pm
New business: Policy JG-R, Elementary School Reassignment Policy, offered by Member Reinfeld (2026-24)
location: Howard Alden Memorial Chambers, Medford City Hall, and via remote participation (Zoom)
